title: Faithfully flat testing of transport axioms
statement: Let X prime to X be flat and surjective, p:X to Y, V over X, and V prime its cartesian base change. Suppose E is a descent datum on V prime relative to X prime to Y [def-pd-descent-datum]. A morphism t:V times_Y X to V over the second X-factor, whose transport on all X prime-valued test points agrees with E, determines a descent datum D on V relative to X to Y. The cartesian projection identifies D after base change [def-pc-base-change] with E.

proof.text:
A natural universal transport morphism compatible with an actual descent datum after a
 flat surjective base change already satisfies the identity and cocycle axioms. Lift the
 finitely many base maps to the covering scheme by iterated pullbacks. The resulting map to
 the test scheme is flat and surjective, hence epi. Pullback points lift uniquely by the
 cartesian square. Compatibility transfers the identity and cocycle equations from `E`;
 cancel the covering epimorphism to obtain them before base change. Naturality follows from
 the universal property of the pullback defining the universal transport.

Source: Stacks Project, Tags 023V and 02VW.

lean.statement: theorem exists_descentDatum_of_universalTransport {X X' Y : Scheme.{u}} {p : X ⟶ Y} {ι : X' ⟶ X} [Flat ι] [Surjective ι] {p' : X' ⟶ Y} (hp : ι ≫ p = p') (V : Over X) (V' : Over X') (q : V'.left ⟶ V.left) (hq : IsPullback q V'.hom V.hom ι) (E : Over.DescentDatum p' V') (t : pullback (V.hom ≫ p) p ⟶ V.left) (ht : t ≫ V.hom = pullback.snd (V.hom ≫ p) p) (hcompat : ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (f₁ f₂ : T ⟶ X') (h : f₁ ≫ p' = f₂ ≫ p') (a : Over.mk f₁ ⟶ V'), pullback.lift (a.left ≫ q) (f₂ ≫ ι) (by calc (a.left ≫ q) ≫ (V.hom ≫ p) = (a.left ≫ V'.hom) ≫ (ι ≫ p) := by rw [Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc q, hq.w] simp only [Category.assoc] _ = f₁ ≫ p' := by simp only [Over.w a, Over.mk_hom, hp] _ = (f₂ ≫ ι) ≫ p := by rw [Category.assoc, hp, h]) ≫ t = (E.transport f₁ f₂ h a).left ≫ q) : ∃ D : Over.DescentDatum p V, D.IsBaseChange hp hq.w E
